# Design

Four independent slices, one wave. Retrieval (src/graph.c, src/scan.c, src/lang.c, src/resolve.c, src/db.c): declarations get a flag and their own end line at index time, a name-words column feeds symbol_fts, and cmd_context grows a path door (context_path_outline), a phrase ranker over names, comment_fts, and body_fts, and a budget-filling second pass. Code map (src/codemap.c): codemap_render builds the map from the graph tables already there — files, symbols, refs, imports, routes, comments — into one StrBuf with a deterministic order, and cmd_codemap owns the file behind a generated marker. Memory transport (src/memory.c): memory_content_id is sha256 over type, task, and body; export streams JSONL, import reads a file, stdin, or another project's graph.db opened read-only, inside one write transaction. Configuration (src/config.c): config_load parses <root>/codify.kvx with the kvx reader into a cached CgConfig; config_spec_dir replaces every hard-coded \"%s/spec\" join; implicit sync sites ask config_auto_sync first. No new dependency; schema changes stay additive wherever the derived tables allow it.
